STEP 11. Check the sunroof motor assembly connector D-
06 for damage.
Q: Is sunroof motor assembly connector D-06 in good 
condition?
YES : Go to Step 12.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2. The sunroof should 
work normally.
STEP 12. Check the harness wire between sunroof motor 
assembly connector D-06 and ground.
Q: Is the harness wire between sunroof motor assembly 
connotes D-06 and ground in good condition?
YES : There is no action to be taken.
NO : Repair it. The sunroof should work normally.
STEP 13. Check the sunroof switch.
Q: Does the check above meet the table?
YES : Go to Step 14.
NO : Replace the sunroof switch. The sunroof should work 
normally.
